title: I’m a 3D artist who can’t code. Didn’t stop me making a browser topical stealth game about a “certain” tech CEO who stalks your neighbourhood for unsupervised RAM.
author: cormaction
selftext:
Free in the browser: https://ckxlab.itch.io/ram-altman

A certain CEO said on a podcast that it's quite terrible your PC is holding RAM a data centre could be using. This game takes him at his word. You play him, out at night in a hoodie, going house to house collecting memory people have been keeping for themselves. While I was making it he changed his display name to Ram Altman, so now we share a title.

Most of the fun for me was the Silicon Valley side. There's a quarterly target, and a share price that dips if a paparazzo gets a photo of you on someone's lawn. In one house you get a half-asleep man to accept forty pages of terms of service, so it's all legal. The power-ups are biohacks, like kaleido drops for example, multiply whatever you steal by however many mirror images you're seeing. Miss the quarter and the board replaces you with an AI agent. The garden gnomes have unionised. I don't know why either.

I'm a 3D artist and I don't code. The ideas and the look are mine, and Claude wrote the code. Happy to talk about how that split worked.
